summary.text: Welson Chang is the Republican and Queens United Party nominee for NY State Assembly District 24, running against incumbent David Weprin. He describes himself as a small-business owner and naturalized U.S. citizen who founded a manufacturing business in 2020 after a decade in nonprofit administration, and has not previously held elected office. His campaign priorities include lowering taxes, supporting small businesses and keeping Regents exam requirements.

paragraphs.text: According to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, he graduated from Massena Central High School and earned a B.A. in history from McGill University (2000) and an M.S. in accountancy from the University of Phoenix (2020).
Describes himself as a naturalized U.S. citizen since 2008.
Says he spent a decade in nonprofit administration before entering the private sector in 2013, and founded a manufacturing business in 2020.
Became a county committee member in 2022, according to his survey, and says he serves on the boards of the Queens Village Republican Club and the Hollis Court at Bayside Coop.

Member of the Queens Village Republican Club; not formally endorsed by the Queens County Republican Party as of April 2026. He advanced to the general election without a primary after the June 23 Republican primary was canceled.
Spoke at Queens Village Republican Club events in Bayside and Alley Pond Park during the 2026 campaign.
